# DSH Studio v0.9.9

## Changes and security

- Serve the Studio shell from a loopback origin so Harness `0.1.2-rc.1` authenticates in the embedded window without disabling upstream cookie protection.
- Preserve same-site navigation, bound the loopback cookie header, and keep `0.1.1-rc.2` as the bundled baseline.

## Fixes and polish

- Support both generations of the Studio integration client.
- Align the main UI's typography and button feedback, including touch behavior and reduced-motion support.
- Allow Rust-only checks on a clean checkout before Vite has generated `dist/`, with CI coverage for that path.
- Test a real isolated installation and Profile boot of Harness `0.1.2-rc.1` on the CI platforms. The `0.1.5-rc.2` dependency set currently references an unpublished npm version and is not claimed as verified.

## Installation and limitations

- Upgrade in place or use the in-app updater. Full includes offline dependencies; Lite downloads them when needed.
- A selected Harness release still has to pass isolated startup verification; a failed candidate leaves the existing runtime, Profile, and sessions intact.

## Verification

- Windows isolated install and real Profile boot of `0.1.2-rc.1` passed. The local frontend build, lint, 269 frontend tests, 51 packaging tests, and Rust workspace tests passed.
- The release workflow builds and checks Linux, Windows, and macOS artifacts. No physical macOS device was available for validation.
